name: When should I call a professional plumber instead of attempting a DIY repair?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional plumber instead of attempting a DIY repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional plumber when facing complex issues like burst pipes, main sewer line backups, water heater malfunctions, or persistent leaks that you can't identify or stop. For new installations, like replacing a water heater or adding a fixture, professional help ensures proper installation and adherence to local codes. If you're unsure about the cause or solution, a professional can diagnose and repair safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional for complex issues like burst pipes, sewer backups, water heater problems, or when you're unsure of the repair.
